headline: CISA ordered federal agencies to patch actively exploited ColdFusion and Langflow flaws by July 10 as China's UAT-7810 expanded its router-based relay network and a 15-year-old Linux kernel bug handed attackers instant root.

emerging_trends.text: Attackers keep converting AI development platforms into breach points, exploiting Langflow in the wild, hijacking Google's Dialogflow CX chatbots through the Rogue Agent flaw, and tricking GitHub agentic workflows into leaking private repositories.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Rogue Agent and Prompt-Injection Flaws Hit AI Platforms

emerging_trends.text: Vulnerabilities that lay dormant for fifteen years keep surfacing, as GhostLock hands any logged-in user full root across nearly every Linux distribution shipped since 2011.

emerging_trends.text: China-linked crews keep building covert relay networks out of edge hardware, as UAT-7810 breaks into unpatched Ruckus routers to grow its LapDogs ORB network.

topics.title: CISA Orders Emergency Patching of ColdFusion, Langflow, and Joomla
topics.latest_developments: CISA added four flaws to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on July 7—Adobe ColdFusion path-traversal CVE-2026-48282 rated 10.0, Langflow auth-bypass CVE-2026-55255, and two Joomla extension flaws—and gave federal agencies until July 10 to patch.
topics.summary: ColdFusion powers commercial web apps and Langflow builds AI agents; attackers exploit both to run code and harvest credentials, the Langflow flaw feeding the JADEPUFFER ransomware operation Sysdig tracked. Patch immediately.

sources.title: CISA Adds 4 Actively Exploited Adobe, Joomla, and Langflow Flaws to KEV
CISA Urges Immediate Patching of Exploited ColdFusion, Langflow, Joomla Flaws
CISA orders feds to patch max severity ColdFusion flaw by Friday
CISA orders feds to prioritize patching Langflow auth bypass flaw

topics.title: Rogue Agent and Prompt-Injection Flaws Hit AI Platforms
topics.latest_developments: Varonis disclosed the Rogue Agent flaw in Google's Dialogflow CX on July 7, letting an attacker with edit rights on one Code Block agent hijack every agent in the same Google Cloud project to read live conversations and steal data, while separate researchers showed a crafted public GitHub Issue can trick AI-powered agentic workflows into leaking private-repository data without authentication.
topics.summary: Both flaws exploit the trust enterprises place in AI agents wired into their infrastructure. Google has fixed Dialogflow CX; teams running agentic GitHub workflows should audit their prompt-injection exposure.

sources.title: Google Dialogflow CX Bug Allowed Attackers to Hijack AI Conversations
Dialogflow CX 'Rogue Agent' Flaw Enabled AI Chatbot Data Theft
Rogue Agent Flaw Could Have Let Attackers Hijack Google Dialogflow CX Chatbots
Critical Vulnerability Exposes GitHub Agentic Workflows to Prompt Injection

topics.title: GhostLock Kernel Bug and Critical UniFi Flaws
topics.latest_developments: Nebula Security disclosed GhostLock (CVE-2026-43499) on July 8, a 15-year-old Linux kernel flaw that gives any logged-in user full root and container escape on essentially every mainstream distribution since 2011, the same day Ubiquiti patched seven critical UniFi flaws including CVE-2026-50746 rated 10.0.
topics.summary: GhostLock needs no special permission, unusual settings, or network access; Ubiquiti's flaws span UniFi Connect, Talk, Access, Protect, and OS and enable privilege escalation and arbitrary command execution. Patch both now.

sources.title: 15-Year-Old GhostLock Flaw Enables Root and Container Escape on Most Linux Distros
Ubiquiti Patches Critical UniFi Flaws Across Connect, Talk, Access, Protect, and OS
Ubiquiti warns of new max severity UniFi OS vulnerability

topics.title: UAT-7810 Grows LapDogs ORB Network With Leash Backdoors
topics.latest_developments: Cisco Talos revealed on July 7 and 8 that China-linked UAT-7810 expanded its LapDogs relay network with three new backdoors—LongLeash, DogLeash, and JarLeash—by breaking into internet-facing devices, chiefly unpatched Ruckus routers.
topics.summary: UAT-7810 maintains LapDogs, an operational relay box network of hijacked small-office routers that hides Chinese espionage traffic, first surfacing in June 2025. The new malware widens the pool of compromised edge devices.

sources.title: China-Linked APT Expands Arsenal With New 'Leash' Backdoors
China-Linked UAT-7810 Expands ORB Network With New LONGLEASH Malware
Chinese hackers develop LONGLEASH malware to expand ORB network

topics.title: Ghost Phishing, ClickFix Banking, and Rent-a-Malware
topics.latest_developments: A fresh EvilTokens 'ghost phishing' campaign hides its malicious page until it decrypts inside the victim's browser to slip past URL checks and steal Microsoft 365 access, as Elastic Security Labs tracked REF6045 dropping the SCMBANKER PowerShell toolkit on Mexican bank customers through fake CAPTCHA ClickFix lures, and Zimperium found RedWing, an Android bank-fraud service renting on Telegram for phone takeover and one-time-code theft.
topics.summary: Each campaign packages account theft for low-skill criminals across the United States, Europe, and Mexico. Harden email verification, block ClickFix clipboard commands, and watch for Android overlay fraud.

sources.title: New Ghost Phishing Wave Is Breaking Traditional Email Security
SCMBANKER Malware Uses ClickFix Lures to Target Mexican Banking Users
RedWing MaaS Packages Android Bank Fraud as a Telegram Rental Service

topics.title: Regulators Target App Stores and Foreign AI
topics.latest_developments: The U.S. Supreme Court on July 7 let the Texas App Store Accountability Act take effect, requiring app-store age verification, while the European Commission adopted a communication in Strasbourg the same day to cut the bloc's reliance on foreign AI systems and scale European cyber capabilities.
topics.summary: Texas now forces Apple and Google to verify user ages after a student advocacy group and a tech trade group failed to stay the law; the EU plan rests on three pillars to make frontier AI safe, accessible, and deployable for European cybersecurity. Both reshape compliance for platforms and vendors.

sources.title: Supreme Court allows Texas app law requiring age verification to take effect
EU unveils cyber plan to reduce reliance on foreign AI systems

business_politics.title: Trump Declares Iran Ceasefire Over as Oil Jumps 7%
business_politics.latest_developments: President Trump said his ceasefire with Tehran is finished, warned of fresh strikes as soon as Wednesday night, and threatened to reimpose a naval blockade, sending Brent crude up more than 7% and Treasury yields higher as U.S. stocks fell.
business_politics.summary: The United States and Iran resumed tit-for-tat bombing after three merchant ships came under fire off Oman, and President Trump's declaration that diplomacy has collapsed drove oil above a 7% gain, lifted global bond yields, and strengthened the dollar as investors fled to safe havens.

business_politics.title: UniCredit Nears Control of Commerzbank
business_politics.latest_developments: UniCredit lifted its stake in Commerzbank to nearly 48% after the tender period closed, putting the Italian bank within reach of majority control of the German lender.
business_politics.summary: Italy's UniCredit raised its holding in Commerzbank, Germany's second-largest listed bank, to about 48% following a takeover push that Berlin and the lender's management have long resisted, moving European banking toward its biggest cross-border consolidation in years.

business_politics.latest_developments: In his warmest meeting yet with Volodymyr Zelensky, Trump agreed to let Kyiv produce its own PAC-3 Patriot interceptors and said he supports Ukrainian long-range strikes deep inside Russia.
business_politics.summary: President Trump granted Ukraine a license to manufacture Patriot air-defense interceptors to counter Russian ballistic-missile attacks, meeting a longstanding demand from President Zelensky and signaling deeper U.S. backing as Kyiv intensifies strikes on Russian ships and refineries.

around_town.title: Parkway East Closes Friday for Bridge Replacement
around_town.latest_developments: Two days out, PennDOT set new traffic patterns along South Braddock Avenue in Edgewood and Swissvale and said Pittsburgh workers built the new 22-million-pound Commercial Street Bridge, though its steel came from outside the region.
around_town.summary: PennDOT will close the Parkway East between the Squirrel Hill Tunnel and the Edgewood/Swissvale exit at 9 p.m. Friday, July 10, for 25 days to slide in the new Commercial Street Bridge, rerouting a highway that carries about 100,000 vehicles a day; the Dutch heavy-lift firm Mammoet will move the span into place.

reading.title: XBOX Cuts; Bundling and the Internet Solvent; Transaction, Coordination, and Sunk Costs
reading.summary: Ben Thompson reads Microsoft's large Xbox layoffs as evidence that its Game Pass subscription bundle failed, using the case to examine how the internet dissolves traditional bundles and how transaction, coordination, and sunk costs shape those outcomes.

reading.title: Let AI Burn
reading.summary: Zitron argues the AI industry's economics are unsustainable and that its inevitable reckoning should be allowed to play out rather than propped up by ever more capital.

reading.title: Beware of Productivity Paradoxes
